Yara Haddad  
Senior Backend Engineer | NexaTech Solutions | San Francisco, CA | yarahaddad@email.com | (415) 555-0198  

Technical Skills  
Backend development with a focus on Go, Python, and PostgreSQL. Designed and scaled REST APIs for high-throughput SaaS platforms. Spearheaded microservices architecture migrations, reducing latency by 30% across multiple services. Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, integrating automated testing for critical paths. Managed Linux-based server environments, optimizing resource allocation for production workloads. Implemented monitoring solutions with Prometheus and Grafana, improving incident response times by 40%. Leveraged AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3) to deploy and scale applications, achieving 99.95% SLA compliance.  

Professional Experience  
At NexaTech Solutions, I led the development of a Go-based microservices platform, consolidating 15 legacy systems into a unified architecture. This effort reduced deployment complexity and improved team onboarding efficiency. I also optimized PostgreSQL query performance for a real-time analytics dashboard, achieving sub-50ms response times under peak load. My work on AWS infrastructure involved designing cost-effective auto-scaling strategies, cutting annual cloud spend by 18% while maintaining high availability.  

Prior to that, I designed a Python-driven API gateway at Aurora Systems, which supported 2M+ requests per day. The solution integrated with internal monitoring tools, enabling proactive issue resolution. I also mentored junior engineers on best practices for REST API design, resulting in a 25% reduction in API-related support tickets.  

At ScaleFlow SaaS, I contributed to a CI/CD pipeline overhaul, streamlining deployment workflows and reducing release cycles from weeks to days. My role in Linux administration involved setting up secure server environments, which became the foundation for the company’s DevOps practices.
